label: caiso 59 reserve coopt
definition: (PROBE, issue #1492 / L-10) caiso-51 + the new CAISO per-generator energy+reserve co-optimization (_caiso_design): BAL-002-WECC-3 contingency requirement (max(MSSC, 6% load), half spin/half non-spin) priced by the published tariff §27.1.2.3.5 scarcity demand curves (spin 10% flat / non-spin 50/60/70% at 70/210 MW), Spin+Non-Spin co-drawn on one ramp10-bounded pergen pool. RESULT: real but LARGELY INERT (the MISO lesson) — the ~12.9 GW ramp-deliverable pool dwarfs the ~2.2 GW requirement, so it fires in only 100 hours of 2023 (reserve price up to $800 = spin $100 + non-spin $700, confirming the co-opt sums the product duals) and is idle in 2024/2025. Effect vs the caiso59_reserve_ab_base twin: C3a mean LMP +$0.47 in 2023 only (+0.0 in 2024/2025); C3c DA-expressible >$200 tail UNCHANGED (2023 483h model vs 41h DA / 21h RT actual; +16 zone-hours, 0 net system-hours). Answers the ~455h-vs-21h driver question NEGATIVE: the 2023 over-tail is NOT a missing-reserve-scarcity gap — adding the published reserve co-opt leaves it at 483h; it is owned by the evening-merit / RA-commitment-uplift gap (FINDING-caiso-evening-merit-2026-07-04). Structural mechanism kept per rule 1 (default-off caiso_reserve_coopt). Storage/hydro/regulation are documented next increments. Determination NOT-YET (governance UNATTESTED — probe).
